info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Behavior Insights Management API
info.description: The Customer Behavior Insights Management API provides businesses with critical insights into customer interactions and preferences. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can update existing customer behavior data, enabling them to refine marketing strategies and enhance customer experiences. Typical consumers include data analysts and marketing teams looking to leverage customer insights for targeted initiatives. This API plays a key role in fostering data-driven decision-making within customer management systems.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the behavior insights for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. You can modify various attributes of the customer's behavior based on insights gathered from their interactions.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary data to update customer behavior insights for the specified customer. The payload should adhere to the defined schema and must include the required fields for a successful update.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
